statuses.name: KEY_ABSENT
statuses.message: no option in the set carries that key

statuses.name: KEY_DUPLICATE
statuses.message: the key is already present; a set's keys are unique

statuses.name: VALUE_TYPE_MISMATCH
statuses.message: the value's width does not match the slot's

statuses.name: KEY_TYPE_MISMATCH
statuses.message: the key's declared type does not match the set's

statuses.name: NO_VALUE
statuses.message: the option is unary and carries no value

statuses.name: POLICY_REJECTED
statuses.message: the merge policy refused this position

statuses.name: CONFLICT
statuses.message: the sets conflict; their plain union is not defined

statuses.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
statuses.message: an argument was null, aliased, or out of range

statuses.name: BUFFER_TOO_SMALL
statuses.message: the destination is too small; the required size is reported
